title: EM4305 RFID Cards
description: EM4305 rewritable 125 kHz RFID cards for access control, hotel keys and LF migration projects, with configurable memory for credential formats.
summary: EM4305 cards are rewritable 125 kHz RFID credentials with configurable memory, making them suitable for LF system migration, hotel lock cards and other programmable proximity deployments.
Frequency: The EM4305 card operates at 125 kHz.
Unique Identifier (UID): Each card has a 32-bit unique identifier.

faq.question: What are EM4305 RFID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for rewritable low-frequency credentials, hotel lock cards, and LF migration projects that need configurable memory and format flexibility.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for EM4305 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: EM4305 Protocol: ISO18000-2 Frequency: 125 kHz Read Range: 2-10cm, depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for EM4305 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, PET, PETG, ABS, PC, wood, paper. Size: CR80 (85.5*54mm) or customized. Color: White. Black, green, blue, etc., can be customized.

faq.question: How can EM4305 RFID Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Offset Printing, Silk-screen printing, UV printing, digital printing, etc
